owner_decision: EW2-6 (2026-10-08): the 2026-12-01 reserved read and the registration sequencing replaced by a same-day backtest; the configuration was selected on the development frames and committed before this read, and nothing here was tuned on a reserved-frame number
ship_rule: EW2-7: ship eFV v3 if its within Spearman beats served eFV (V2) on both reserved frames (point estimates, pooled over sides); copy claims 'beats consensus' only if its CI95 lower bound is above 0
